summary: This short note is a stub about Pope John III of Alexandria. It gives one historical point of context: during his papacy, Marwan I was the Muslim ruler in Damascus, and after the deaths of Yazid and his son Muawiya II, Marwan I took control of the East and of Egypt. The note contains no further biographical details about the pope.
one_line: Stub note on Pope John III of Alexandria, linking his papacy to Marwan I's takeover of the East and Egypt after the deaths of Yazid and Muawiya II.
key_facts: Pope John III of Alexandria's papacy overlapped with the rule of Marwan I, the Muslim ruler in Damascus.
Yazid was the son of Mu'âwiyah.
Muawiya II was the son of Yazid.
After the death of Yazid and his son Muawiya II, Marwan I took control of the East and of Egypt.
